pages.learnerAction: Ask any real question left from pre-study; otherwise continue directly to the live discussion.

pages.pedagogicalValue: Seeds multiple defensible angles for the later conversation while preserving class time for speaking.
pages.failureDiagnosis: No article question is not a failure; confusion about a selectively glossed term identifies local vocabulary support.
pages.nonTargetSupport: Ten aligned Japanese claim translations are available; this full article owns these selective glosses: humiliation=屈辱.

pages.choiceQuality: Sentence reveals offer optional bilingual support; they are not graded choices or distractors.
